mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with a three-month decline in FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) over the past two months indicates a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 over the past two months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate capacity utilization and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with a three-month decline in INDPRO, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units over the past two months indicates a cooling housing market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST falls below 1300, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with a three-month decline in PAYEMS, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates a severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
